title: Abhayagiri Vihāra
geometryBasis: The identified circular footprint fixes the center. The mapped enclosing wall sets the orientation and outdoor terrace dimensions.
sectionBasis: Smither’s measured section as published by Parker establishes the three basal rings, square chamber, stone frontispieces and dome outline. The engineering survey and Central Cultural Fund records report the modern exterior size and the restoration of the brick cap and spire.
limitations: The standing main stupa and its immediate stone enclosure are covered. The outer archaeological complex and museum are outside this model.
Individual carved figures and local brick erosion are approximated. The spire follows the restored overall height published in 2015.
